flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for a court application batch, error notices or an OIC work item. Only placeholders exist: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItemForPRSC and similar, log only), entity OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail (batch_no commented out), ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty).
note: URA status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault permission for the api App Service server; cannot verify from repo). The story asks OCMS to create a work item with the error notices and error reasons and route it to the OIC dashboard. No code runs the court application batch flow (no batch number, no per-batch particulars update, no error list). The words 'work item' only appear in DataHiveUenFinService as a placeholder: createWorkItemForPRSC (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924) only writes the log '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped', and the tables ocms_work_item / ocms_work_item_allocation / ocms_work_item_notices are mentioned in comments (:2907-2912) with no entity or repository in any repo. The staff dashboard (Dashboard.tsx) is an empty div. No relevant maintenance ticket. The 'Demo paid' status is not supported by repo code for this story.
recommendation: Not supported by repo code. Do not claim as done; ask URA/team in which repo the court application batch and OIC work item flow is built, or mark it as a gap

steps.step: Notices in the court application batch whose latest particulars could not be received/updated from the agencies are identified as error notices
steps.detail: There is no court application batch: the batch_no column in OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail is commented out with the label 'NOT USED NOW' in both APIs (OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail.java:66-68 in ocmsadminprivateapi, :60-62 in ocmsadminapi). Agency particulars updates only exist in the generic MHA/DataHive crons that are not tied to a court batch. grep with no result in the six repos for court_app / courtapp / court application / shortlist / court_batch / csd_batch / ocms_work_item (other than DataHive placeholder comments and UI labels).

steps.step: The error reason is stored per notice together with the list of error notices
steps.detail: No entity, column or table was found for a court application error notice list with its reason. The only court entity (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31 in ocmsadminapi) only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason for the PLUS/CAS payment integration, not batch errors.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item containing the error notices and the reasons for error
steps.detail: createWorkItemForPRSC only logs '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped ... feature not ready' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924); the comment at :2907-2914 mentions ocms_work_item, ocms_work_item_allocation, ocms_work_item_notices and 'Work item creation is not ready yet'. That is also for the FIN/Work Pass flow, not court application. grep for ocms_work_item / OcmsWorkItem in the six repos: only these comments, no entity/repository.

steps.step: The work item is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.detail: The staff dashboard (index and '/*' routes, App.tsx:79,81) renders a Dashboard that only contains an empty div (Dashboard.tsx:22-30). There is no work item list, work item API or allocation to the OIC (ocms_work_item_allocation is only mentioned in a comment, DataHiveUenFinService.java:2911).

steps.step: The OIC can review whether to proceed with or reject the notices from the court application batch
steps.detail: There is no review screen, proceed/reject button or endpoint for the OIC's decision on court batch notices. Only a report menu 'Court Application Vault Reports' with an empty path exists (Report/index.tsx:61-64) and a commented-out courtcasesummary resource (ActionReport.tsx:36-42); there is no courtcasesummary controller in the backend (api-authorization.properties only maps /v1/courtcase).
